subject: Post-call cost snapshot & recommended next steps for ApexAI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@apexai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call cost snapshot & recommended next steps for ApexAI

Hi Samir / Elena — thanks again for the call this morning. Below is a concise recap of what we heard, a high-level cost snapshot based on the usage profile you shared, and recommended next steps so we can move to a scoped pilot quickly.

Recap of pain & goals (from today)
- Primary pain: inference spend is spiking unpredictably and is the largest item in your ML infra bill.
- Latency variability during bursts is impacting SLA for interactive products.
- You want a predictable monthly spend and a path to reduce token cost without sacrificing model quality.
- Internal goal: reduce inference cost by ~30–50% in the next 3–6 months while preserving >95% parity on customer-facing responses.

Profile we used for the snapshot
- Average prompt length: 350 tokens; average generated tokens per request: 420 tokens.
- Avg QPS: 25 sustained, with burst spikes to ~120 for short periods.
- Estimated monthly active requests: ~1.8M -> monthly tokens ~1.37B (prompt + generation).

High-level cost snapshot (order-of-magnitude) — hosted vs dedicated vs private
- Hosted (managed): $0.018 / 1k generated tokens (model family X), baseline monthly estimate: ~$24k.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): amortized infra + license equivalent: ~$12k–$15k per month for similar throughput (depends on commitment).
- Private (on-prem/VPC): higher fixed setup + infra ops; break-even ~12–18 months at current scale.

Primary levers we recommend
1) Batching & concurrency tuning: shave per-token overhead by 15–25% for throughput-heavy paths.
2) KV/prefix caching for repetitive system prompts & reuse across sessions — can reduce generated tokens by 10–30% on templated flows.
3) Quantization (8-bit) + model distillation/variant testing for non-critical paths: 20–40% cost reduction with small quality risk.
4) Routing policies: send low-stakes requests to smaller, cheaper model variants and high-stakes to the higher-quality model.

Proposed next steps (quick wins)
- Run a 4-week pilot: Redwood Dedicated + batching/caching enabled on a subset of routes. Goal: validate 30% unit-cost reduction and stable latency under burst.
- Deliverable: pilot cost baseline + projected 12-month TCO with recommended commit levels.
- Timeline: kickoff next week, pilot instrumentation in 2 weeks, 4-week measurement window.

Attachments: APX-inference-snapshot-03-15.xlsx (cost model), pilot-scope-and-milestones.pdf

If this aligns, I’ll send a short MOU + pilot SOW and Marissa will scope the technical checklist.

Ben

From: Samir Gupta <samir@apexai.com>

Date: 2026-03-16T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call cost snapshot & recommended next steps for ApexAI

Thanks Ben — good summary and aligned with what we discussed. A few clarifications and constraints from our side:
- Budget frame: we have a Q2 cap of $18k/month for inference until exec review (targeting a reduction to trigger expansion).
- Critical workflows: customer chat and release-notes generator are highest priority for latency SLOs; internal analytics is lower priority and can go to cheaper variants.
- Compliance: we need audit logs and token retention controls for the customer-facing product (can be part of pilot).

Can you:
1) Update the snapshot to show a scenario that hits $18k/mo by applying batching + quantization + routing?
2) Confirm whether we’d need a 6- or 12-month commitment to realize the dedicated numbers you quoted.

Happy to run the pilot. Let’s cc Monica to ensure we capture post-pilot roll criteria.

—Samir
Samir Gupta | Head of Platform Engineering, ApexAI
samir@apexai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@apexai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-16T13:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call cost snapshot & recommended next steps for ApexAI

Thanks Samir — yes, we can get a scenario to $18k/month. Quick notes:
- Path to $18k: combine moderate batching (concurrency tuning targeting 25% less overhead), prefix KV caching on chat flows (expect 15% token reduction), and an 8-bit quantized model variant for analytics flows (20–30% cheaper tokens).
- Commitment: Dedicated pricing (the $12k–$15k range) assumes a 6-month minimum reserve. We can structure a 3-month pilot with optional conversion credits if you sign a 12-month commit after pilot.

I’ve asked Marissa to attach a short tech appendix that maps the pilot routes to the levers above and the instrumentation we’ll need. Monica — do you want to add any customer success acceptance criteria?

Action items I’ll take this week:
- Update the attached spreadsheet with an $18k/mo scenario and three breakpoints (no changes, batching+caching, batching+caching+quant).
- Draft a short pilot SOW and MOU for signature.

Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Gupta <samir@apexai.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Tech appendix: pilot tuning, metrics, and instrumentation

Hi Samir — quick technical follow-up from our side about pilot scope and what we’ll instrument to measure unit economics: 

Pilot routes (proposed)
- chat.customer-facing (high SLO) -> measure p95 latency, token reuse rate, SLA errors
- content.generate (release notes) -> measure end-to-end latency, quality delta vs baseline
- analytics.batch -> cheaper model, high batching, measure cost/throughput

Instrumentation & metrics
- Token bookkeeping at route level (prompt vs generated)
- Effective batch size and queue latency distribution (to ensure SLOs preserved)
- Cache hit rate for prefix/KV cache and observed token savings
- Per-route cost breakdown, per-million-token unit cost (post-batching/quantization)
- Baseline quality checks: sample-set evaluations + rollback thresholds

Acceptance criteria (CS)
- >=30% reduction in effective unit cost on targeted routes OR total monthly cost <= $18k with <=5% quality regression on primary flows
- No sustained p95 latency regression > 20% vs baseline for customer-facing chat

Next steps
- Ben: updated cost spreadsheet (today EOD PT)
- Marissa & Ben: pilot SOW draft (by 2026-03-19)
- ApexAI: sign MOU to start provisioning (we can provision infra within 2 business days of sign)

I’ll attach a short checklist with the instrumentation endpoints once Ben drops the updated spreadsheet.

Thanks — Marissa
